<div class="card-body">
'''Dice Ibegon''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[Dice Ibegon]].<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 98 (index 3944). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>


<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ダイス・アイビゴン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">同じ位置で、相手のキャラクターが武器を起動した際、１フォース消費して、突起で攻撃することができる（１ターンに１回だけ）。対象を選んで運命数を引き、運命数＝能力値なら、命中する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-dice-ibegon-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ラック・シヴラックの酒飲み仲間。フローーン・ランプロイドの女性。突起で獲物に毒を刺す狩猟者。フォースに同調し、時間の流れを変えることができるという。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Dice Ibegon.

'''Card text:''' When an opposing character fires a weapon at the same site, you may use 1 Force to attack with her appendage, once per turn. Choose a target and draw destiny. The attack hits if destiny equals the target's ability.

'''Lore:''' Lak Sivrak's drinking companion. A female Florn Lamproid, a hunter who injects poison into prey with a protruding appendage. She is attuned to the Force, with a reputation for being able to alter the flow of time.
